chunks: Muhammad ibn Umar al-Hafiz al-Baghdadi (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Musa narrated to us. He said: Khalaf ibn Salim narrated to us. He said: Ghandar narrated to us. He said: Awf narrated to us, from Maymun Abu Abdullah, from Zayd ibn Arqam. He said:

For a group from the companions of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family), there were doors opening onto the mosque. So one day he said: Close these doors except the door of Ali. So the people spoke about that. He said: So the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) stood, praised Allah and commended Him, then said: As for what comes after, indeed I was commanded to close these doors except the door of Ali, and some of you spoke about that. Indeed, by Allah, I did not close anything nor open it, but rather I was commanded with something, so I followed it.

key_terms.أمرت بشئ فاتبعته: I was commanded with something so I followed it
key_terms.سدوا هذه الابواب إلا باب علي: close these doors except the door of Ali

ai.seo_question: What is the hadith about closing all doors to the mosque except the door of Ali?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad ordered all doors opening into the mosque to be closed except the door of Ali ibn Abi Talib. When some companions questioned this, the Prophet stood to address them, swearing by Allah that he acted not of his own accord but by divine command. This hadith, narrated by the Companion Zayd ibn Arqam, is a well-known tradition (hadith sadd al-abwab) emphasizing Ali's unique spiritual proximity to the Prophet and the mosque.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Umar al-Hafith al-Baghdadi (rh) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Musa narrated to us. He said: Khalaf b. Salim narrated to us. He said: Ghandar narrated to us. He said: `Awf narrated to us from Maymun Abi `Abdillah from Zayd b. Arqam. He said:

For a group from the companions of the Messenger of Allah (s), there were doors from the street to the Mosque. So, one day, he said: Close these doors except the door of `Ali. So, the people spoke about that. He said: So, the Messenger of Allah (s) stood, praised Allah and commended Him, then said: As for what comes after: surely, I was ordered to have these doors closed except for the door of `Ali, and some of you spoke about that. Surely, by Allah, I did not close or open anything, but rather I was ordered with something, so I obeyed it.
